title: Product: one flow from first contact to payment
description: CRM and proposals, resource planning, timesheets and invoicing in one flow. Each team hears what happens elsewhere that affects their work.
primaryQuery: resource planning and invoicing software for services firms
h1: One flow, from first contact to final payment
lead: implesta follows a piece of work through every team that touches it: sales, delivery, planning, finance. Each step tells the next what it needs to know, so nothing is typed twice and nobody has to chase.
flowTitle: Four parts, in the order work happens

signals.text: When something happens in one part of the flow, the people it affects hear about it: in the notification bell and in the For you list in My Space, next to the client or project it concerns. Only what matters to their role, once, and never about their own actions.

examples.title: Deal likely to close this week: Haverland Foods
examples.line: 480 h from next Monday. Line up people before it is signed.

examples.title: Hours over budget: Packaging line commissioning
examples.line: 460 of 400 h. Talk to the client before the next invoice.

examples.title: Prepare invoice: Packaging line commissioning
examples.line: Last month's approved hours. Lines, rates and client details are filled in.

items.title: My Space
items.text: Each person's own page: what is planned for them today and coming up, time logging, leave and the signals meant for them.

items.title: Client portal
items.text: Clients review proposals, sign online, follow milestones and approve hours from a secure link, without an account.

items.title: Roles and audit log
items.text: Access follows each person's role, and every change to clients, deals, proposals and invoices is recorded. More on [security](page:security).

final.h2: See the whole flow with your own kind of project
